tools.name: get_top_protocols
tools.description: Get top DeFi protocols by TVL. Optionally filter by chain (e.g. 'Ethereum', 'Cardano').

tools.name: get_protocol_tvl
tools.description: Get detailed TVL data for a specific protocol. Use slug format e.g. 'liqwid-finance', 'aave', 'uniswap'.

tools.name: get_chain_tvl_ranking
tools.description: Get TVL ranking across all blockchain networks.

tools.name: get_top_yield_pools
tools.description: Get top yield farming pools. Filter by minimum APY and optionally by chain.

tools.name: get_stablecoin_summary
tools.description: Get stablecoin market overview: total market cap, top stablecoins, peg status.

tools.name: get_protocol_fees
tools.description: Get protocol fee revenue for the last N days. Use slug e.g. 'aave', 'uniswap-v3'.

tools.name: search_protocols
tools.description: Search DeFi protocols by name or keyword. Returns matching protocols with TVL.

tools.name: get_rwa_attestation
tools.description: Get RWA-Attest protocol score and attestation data. Known protocols: liqwid, aave, compound, maker, spark, euler, radiant, morpho.

tools.name: get_governance_activity
tools.description: Get active governance proposals across DeFi protocols. Ecosystem filter: 'cardano', 'ethereum', 'aave', etc.

tools.name: get_market_narrative
tools.description: Get current X/Twitter market narrative and sentiment for a DeFi topic. Examples: 'BTC DeFi', 'Aave governance', 'stablecoin depeg risk', 'Cardano DeFi TVL'.
